name: Streak Shield
description: Auto-consumes to prevent one streak reset when you miss a day.
flavor: A ward against the dark between days. Hold fast, and the flame stays lit.

name: Tome of Experience
description: Multiplies XP earned on your next activity.
flavor: Ink that bleeds into muscle. Every step counts for more.

name: Merchant's Seal
description: Multiplies Gold earned on your next activity.
flavor: Sealed in wax from a long-dead trader's hand. The coin knows its keeper.

name: Lucky Charm
description: Doubles the chance of a bonus drop on your next activity.
flavor: A coin struck on the wrong side. Fortune favors those who carry it — briefly.

name: Endurance Elixir
description: Bonus XP if your next activity runs longer than 60 minutes.
flavor: Three herbs and a secret. Go long, and the elixir goes with you.

name: Trailblazer's Map
description: Bonus XP on elevation gain during your next activity.
flavor: Scrawled in a different hand on every corner. The mountain marks you as it lets you pass.
